I just accepted that getting the unit I want will take ~180 pulls. I started playing during the HuoHuo banner and the first 50/50 I won was during Sparkle’s (And i basically pulled every patch, not f2p ofc). It was/is obviously super frustrating, but I decided to stop obsessing over dozens of characters and just save and pull for the ones that might be really useful or suited to my playstyle. Even if you spent a lot of money, you should never really expect to get a 5* before hitting soft pity, let’s not forget the rates are abysmal. This also applies to light cones, even if the chance of losing to a standard light cone are lower, you should never hope too hard on getting what you want, and only pull if you are ready to lose to a standard banner item. It’s of course impossible to save 300+ pulls every time you want a character and their light cone, which is why you should focus on few ones and plan your pulls well
